title: Job Openings at Health Haus
content:
Health Haus is recruiting suitably qualified candidates to fill the following positions below:

1.) Senior Laboratory Technician

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are looking for an experienced Senior Laboratory Technician / Quality Manager to oversee laboratory activities, quality standards and compliance while ensuring accurate and reliable results.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Oversee day-to-day laboratory operations and testing activities.
	Ensure laboratory procedures meet required quality and safety standards.
	Maintain quality control records, documentation and reports.
	Monitor equipment, calibration, maintenance and laboratory supplies.
	Implement and monitor quality assurance procedures.
	Identify and address quality issues and support continuous improvement.
	Ensure compliance with applicable laboratory, health and safety requirements.
	Train and supervise laboratory staff where required.


Requirements


	Degree / HND in Medical Laboratory Science, Biomedical Science, Chemistry or a related field.
	Minimum 6 years of relevant laboratory and/or quality management experience.
	Strong knowledge of laboratory quality control and assurance procedures.
	Experience with laboratory equipment, documentation and quality systems.
	Strong attention to detail and analytical skills.
	Good leadership, communication and organisational skills.
	Ability to work independently and maintain high professional standards.


Salary
To be discussed.

Application Closing Date: 22nd September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Resume to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

 

2.) Sales Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are looking for an experienced and results driven Sales Manager to lead sales activities, develop new business opportunities and contribute to the company’s growth.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue targets.
	Identify and develop new customers and business opportunities.
	Manage and maintain strong customer relationships.
	Lead, motivate and support the sales team.
	Monitor sales performance, targets and market trends.
	Prepare sales reports and provide regular updates to management.
	Represent the company professionally with customers and business partners.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in business, Marketing, Sales or a related field and a minimum 5 years of experience in sales, with experience across multiple industries preferred.
	Proven track record of achieving sales targets.
	Strong negotiation, communication and relationship-management skills.
	Good understanding of business development and market expansion.
	Ability to work independently and manage a team.
	Strong Microsoft Office and reporting skills.
	Excellent communication skills


Salary
To be discussed.

Application Closing Date: 22nd September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Resume to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

 

3.) Administration Officer

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role


	We are looking for an experienced and highly organised Administrative Officer to support the smooth day to day operations of our Lagos office.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage daily office administration and documentation.
	Maintain accurate records, files and company documents.
	Coordinate office supplies, vendors, facilities and general administrative requirements.
	Support management and employees with administrative and operational matters.
	Coordinate meetings, travel arrangements and other office activities.
	Ensure administrative procedures are followed and information is handled confidentially.


Requirements


	HND / Bachelor’s Degree in business administration, Management or a related field.
	Minimum 8 years of relevant administrative experience.
	Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and Word.
	Excellent organisational, communication and coordination skills.
	Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
	High level of professionalism, discretion and attention to detail.


Salary
To be discussed.

Application Closing Date: 21st September, 2026.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Resume to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.
